title: Decorative fill with psc-deco-1line.plf on an off-centre 40 x 60 mm rectangle
description: A 40 x 60 mm rectangle at (10, 20) mm on the 100 mm page sewn as decorative fill with the owner-made psc-deco-1line.plf at 100 x 100 mm: the tile is centred on the rectangle's box (30, 50), so the line runs from the left edge 10 mm below the top to the right edge 10 mm above the bottom (page y = x + 20 mm), split evenly at the run pitch, joined by travel along the outline at 2 mm. PE-DESIGN also walks the whole outline and sews the line three times (357 needle points against OpenStitch's 83); neither the count nor the height (PE-DESIGN's walk reaches the top 10 mm, OpenStitch's travel does not) is compared.
